ELPAC Level 2 · Lexile BR–300L

Seven Flights, One Door

SSF-HS9-L2-BR300-HSSCIPHY-ESC-LAT
THE DIRECTIONS

You will talk to four people. Record what you would say to each one. You can record again as many times as you want. When all four are recorded, click Submit.

The first time you press record, your computer will ask to use your microphone. Click Allow.

The door code

As you record, the four numbers fill in. Multiply the first three. Then divide by the last number times itself.

?kgTHE ASTRONAUT
?newtons per kgEARTH'S PULL
?of Earth's massMARS MASS
?as wide as EarthMARS WIDTH
EARTHMARS
THE SCENE

You are playing the science club's escape room. You are alone in the last room, and the clock is running. The door code is how hard Mars pulls on one astronaut. You need four numbers to find it. Four people each can help you.

THE HISTORY

This escape room is about Franklin Chang Díaz. He was born in Costa Rica in 1950. He flew to space seven times. Now his company builds a rocket to reach Mars faster.
